title: PA-26-04: Updates to the Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance and the Officials’ Individual Search Collection, and New Additional Certification Form
summary: The Program Advisory explains the updates to the Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance and the updated document types in the Officials’ Individual Disclosures Search Collection related to ethics agreement compliance. The Advisory also announces a new Additional Certification form for those Presidential appointees subject to Senate confirmation (PAS officials) who have more than one ethics agreement compliance date.
